svg.title: kahlnws
svg.desc: A small network whose spanning tree is drawn in bold, with one more arc entering it, beside the name kahlnws, the languages it is offered in (Rust, C, C++, Python) and the line: a primal network simplex for min-cost flow on exact integers. Every letter is an outline, so the picture needs no font. It carries its own ground, so it reads on a page of either colour.
